name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aerodynamics, sparked by her father's work as an aircraft mechanic. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from McGill University, she secured an internship at a small racing team before specializing in wind tunnel operations. Her meticulous nature and deep understanding of fluid dynamics quickly made her an invaluable asset. 

Isabelle is driven by a desire to optimize performance and extract every last ounce of potential from the cars. She believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing wind tunnel results to identify areas for improvement. Her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights sets her apart. She is known for pushing boundaries and isn't afraid to challenge conventional thinking to find the edge that separates winning from losing. 

Now at PEX Motorsport, Isabelle has already made significant contributions, improving aerodynamic efficiency by a measurable amount. Her colleagues appreciate her dedication and unwavering commitment to excellence. She has become a mentor to junior staff, and hopes to continue to make her mark on the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: She is of average height with an athletic build, honed from years of competitive swimming.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in the wind tunnel.
Has a lucky charm, a small toy plane, that sits on her workstation.
Fiercely competitive, even in casual office games.
